summary.note: all four fall in UNCLEAR by the 0.10/0.50 rule, but the raw values are tight: 0.2282-0.2790 (range 0.05) with NN-supported 1.0000 in every run. room_02's same statistic splits 0.007 vs 0.66-0.69 (range 0.68). The classification threshold is too coarse for hall_01; the comparison that matters is the within-dataset spread.

qualifiers.1_threshold_not_used_as_mode: the preregistered 0.10/0.50 rule classifies all four hall_01 runs as UNCLEAR, so the stability conclusion rests on the RAW unsupported values (0.2282-0.2790, range 0.0508) and on NN-supported being 1.0000 in every run -- not on 'four runs share a mode'. The threshold is the shape of the room_02 distribution and must not be transplanted to another dataset.
qualifiers.2_scope: hall_01, no injection, window 100-160 s, reference is the clean run's map (a proxy, not GT), n=4 runs, one host build (exec 76359f53 + lib 6337ec0f), NO_MP + DET_SYNC, taskset 0-7.
qualifiers.what_this_does_not_claim: no root cause for the room_02 bimodality; the check only bounds where it does and does not appear.
